topics.caution: The closing line 'કર્મ અને ધર્મ તેણે એક કરી મૂક્યાં છે' uses 'ધર્મ' idiomatically for duty/work-ethic; the explanation could mistakenly turn this into a statement about Ba's religious observance or piety.
topics.guidance: Gloss 'ધર્મ' here as her sense of duty/responsibility fused with her daily work, not as religious practice — keep the explanation about her resilience and work ethic after બાપુજીનું અવસાન, never about faith or ritual.

topics.caution: 'બાને છાબડી ભરી ભરીને મંદિરમાં ફૂલો મોકલતાં મેં જોઈ છે' describes Ba sending flowers to the temple; the explanation or real_life_example could drift into presenting temple flower-offering as a religious instruction or duty the child should follow.
topics.guidance: Keep this as one more instance of Ba's ઉદારતા (generosity) alongside giving limdo, lemons and vegetables to neighbours — the literary point is her open-handedness, not temple ritual; the real_life_example should stay in the child's own world (sharing something home-grown with a neighbour), not a devotional instruction.
